jobs.title: Senior (Principal) Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your tasks:

As Senior Product Manager Acquisition and Growth, you are the driving force behind scaling Statista’s digital revenue engine and ensure that we generate high quality and quantity of leads and our products effectively convert, activate, and retain users across the entire funnel.

  • Contribute to Statista’s product strategy with a clear vision for acquisition and growth, focusing on lead generation, digital sales, and user activation

  • Lead continuous discovery to deeply understand customer needs and maintain an opportunity backlog, including AI prototypes for solution ideas

  • Drive quarterly OKR alignment, define priorities, and shape the product roadmap in close collaboration with your Engineering Manager and leadership

  • Own and manage key business KPIs, regularly track performance, and derive actionable insights and validate hypothesis in A/B tests to optimize conversion and growth

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and MarTech to deliver the best possible business outcomes

  • Optimize the end-to-end user journey including paywall, onboarding, and activation flows to increase registrations, purchases, and engagement

Your profile:

  • Strong background (8+ years) in digital product management within complex and data driven environments, ideally in B2B SaaS or digital subscription models

  • Strategic and analytical thinker, based on first principles, with a customer-centric mindset and the ability to form and validate hypotheses on both strategic and operational levels

  • Clarity in communication – with customers, engineering, revenue colleagues and leadership

  • Familiarity with AI-driven products and enthusiasm to adopt AI tools and integrate them into product development and daily workflows

  • Track record of driving product discovery, executing agile development processes, and making data-informed decisions

  • Experience working with acquisition, conversion optimization, and onboarding funnels, with a strong understanding of digital sales mechanics

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally, align diverse stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with sales and marketing teams

  • Ability to balance long-term product strategy with technical considerations such as scalability and tech debt management

Your team:

You’ll join an existing, highly skilled and motivated Product Engineering team with an Engineering Manager as your counterpart. Reporting to the Director Product GTM, you’ll work closely with other product managers, engineers, designers, and data experts who are passionate about experimenting, innovating, and driving our product mission of enabling people with trusted data.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

jobs.title: Implementation Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
About us

SFG20 is the industry standard for building maintenance. Providing services and pioneering technologies that empower people to create and sustain safer buildings.

Our mission is to make buildings better using our standard, software and expertise. Our vision is to become the leading authority for built environment maintenance that protects and enhances quality of life.

 

About the role

As an Implementation Delivery Manager, you play a critical role in ensuring customers successfully adopt the SFG20 platform, enabling them to realise value quickly and confidently.

By combining project management expertise with hands-on implementation delivery, you will guide customers from project initiation through to go-live. You will deliver a high-quality onboarding experience, manage implementation projects of varying complexity, and coordinate internal resources to ensure implementations are delivered efficiently, on time, and to a consistently high standard. Your work directly contributes to customer satisfaction, adoption, retention, and long-term success.

 

Key Responsibilities

Customer Implementation & Delivery

  • Lead customers through the implementation journey from project kick-off to successful go-live.

  • Configure customer data within the SFG20 platform using internal systems and implementation tools.

  • Prepare, cleanse, manipulate and validate customer data using Microsoft Excel and other implementation tools.

  • Deliver implementation activities in line with agreed project plans, timelines and quality standards.

  • Conduct customer workshops, implementation meetings and progress updates throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support customers with onboarding activities, system adoption and transition to Business as Usual.

  • Ensure implementation documentation is completed and maintained accurately.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple customer implementation projects simultaneously, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, timescales and budget where applicable.

  • Develop and maintain project plans, monitor milestones and proactively manage project risks and issues.

  • Coordinate activities across internal teams including Customer Success, Product, Sales and Technical teams.

  • Provide regular project reporting and communicate progress clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Escalate project risks appropriately and drive resolution to maintain successful project delivery.

Resource Planning & Capacity Management

  • Support the planning and scheduling of implementation activities across the Implementation team and wider business.

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the ongoing improvement of implementation processes, tools and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer onboarding efficiency and project delivery.

  • Share best practice and lessons learned across the team.

Customer Experience

  • Build trusted relationships with customers, acting as a key point of contact throughout implementation.

  • Deliver a professional, consultative customer experience that reflects SFG20's values.

  • Understand customer requirements and translate these into successful implementation outcomes.

  • Work collaboratively to maximise customer satisfaction and successful adoption of the SFG20 platform.

 

Essential experience

  • Experience within Facilities Management, Building Maintenance or Compliance sectors.

  • Excellent customer-facing communication and relationship management skills.

  • Strong project planning and organisational skills.

  • Experience implementing SaaS or cloud-based software solutions.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data manipulation, validation and analysis.

  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously

  • Comfortable presenting to customers and facilitating workshops.

  • Familiarity with data migration or system configuration activities.

     

Desirable experience

  • Project Management qualification (PRINCE2, APM, Agile, PMP or equivalent).

  • Experience contributing to process improvement initiatives.

  • Experience supporting resource planning or capacity management.

 

Additional Information

All candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. We are unfortunately not able to offer sponsorship. Documentary evidence will be required.

All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting and reference checks.

 

Our Benefits:

  • 🏖 26 days holiday + Bank holidays + buy up to 5 days

  • 🏥 Private Medical insurance with BUPA

  • 🏡 Remote/Hybrid first policy

  • 💙 Employee Assistance programme with WeCare

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Enhanced Family Friendly Benefits

  • 🏋️‍♂️ Gym Discounts

  • 🚀and more!

 

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are our priorities, and we’re ensuring we have lots of support so our people can grow at SFG20 and do their best work!

We embrace diversity by fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, safe and able to bring their whole self to work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Ground Systems (m/f/d)
Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!


About the role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's how you'll make a difference

  • Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.

  • Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.

  • Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

  • Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.

  • Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.

  • Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

What makes you a great fit

  • You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track.

  • You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters.

  • You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem.

  • You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs.

  • You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust.

  • You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them.

  • You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used.

Nice to have

  • Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms.

  • Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization.

  • Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact.

What success looks like

  • 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery.

  • 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier.

  • 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve.

 

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

jobs.title: Junior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're a Series A AI-powered B2B SaaS company operating in the procurement intelligence and supply chain space, backed by top-tier European and global investors. Our ~150-person team is building the next generation of AI-agent-driven procurement tools for the industrial sector — and we're looking for a Junior Product Designer to help define what that looks like.

This is a rare opportunity to shape UX patterns that don't yet exist. You'll help invent how procurement professionals supervise and collaborate with AI agents, moving workflows away from traditional dashboards toward genuinely agentic systems. You'll join a small, cross-functional team shipping weekly to paying customers in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.

Location: On-site in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end product flows, screens, and prototypes that ship to customers within weeks — not quarters.

  • Define how AI agents surface work to users, how humans review and act on it, and how trust is established between people and automated systems.

  • Prototype rapidly in Figma, code, and with AI tools to communicate ideas quickly and clearly.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to reduce handoff friction and maintain design quality through launch.

  • Review pull requests and make last-mile interaction and visual tweaks to ensure what ships matches the design intent.

  • Contribute to and raise the bar on the product design system — visual standards, component consistency, and interaction patterns.

  • Own features from discovery through launch, not just isolated screens.

  • Iterate rapidly based on real customer feedback and production usage data.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 0–2 years of product design experience (strong internships count) with a portfolio of shipped work — ideally in B2B, complex workflows, or data-heavy products.

  • Demonstrated experience contributing to and maintaining a design system with a focus on consistency across a product.

  • Daily use of AI tools in your design workflow (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, v0, Figma Make) for ideation, prototyping, or collaboration.

  • Proven ability to own the end-to-end design lifecycle — from discovery and problem framing through to launched, production-quality features.

  • Strong visual and interaction design instincts with an eye for system-level consistency.

  • Practical understanding of the design-to-development handoff and a track record of close cross-functional collaboration.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a clear bias for shipping over endless polish.

Bonus points for:

  • Prototyping experience in code (HTML, CSS, React).

  • Experience designing for non-technical users navigating complex domains.

  • Considered opinions on how AI should appear and behave in products beyond a chat interface.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is fully on-site in Munich, Germany. You must be available to work from our Munich office. Visa sponsorship is not available — candidates must have existing authorisation to work in Germany.

Our product is used daily by non-technical procurement professionals who need AI to feel natural, trustworthy, and genuinely useful — not like a black box bolted onto a legacy workflow.

We're hiring a Senior or Staff Product Designer to join a small, high-craft design team embedded closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts.   • Design workflows that position AI and human judgment as collaborators, not competitors, with a clear focus on trust and transparency.

  • Senior-level product design experience with a strong portfolio of shipped work — ideally in B2B SaaS, complex workflows, or data-heavy products.

  • A "block-shaped" designer: solid across visual design, interaction design, product thinking, and prototyping in code — not a single-specialty generalist.

Aufgaben

  • Als IT Projektmanager (m/w/d) leiten und steuern Sie internationale Kundenprojekte zur Implementierung von Softwarelösungen im Bereich Instandhaltung und Flottenmanagement

  • Zusätzlich sind Kenntnisse im Umfeld Instandhaltung, Werkstattprozesse oder Flottenmanagement von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten im Gleitzeitmodell

  • Vielseitigkeit: Freuen Sie sich auf spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend + Frontend)
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll work across our entire stack: Java backend services and the TypeScript/Angular frontend that power Soda Cloud. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll own features end-to-end, talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship from database to UI without waiting for hand-offs. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

What You'll Do

  • Build features end-to-end: backend APIs, database changes, frontend UI, and ship them to production yourself.
  • Design and implement backend services for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling.
  • Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way.
  • Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e).
  • Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues.
  • Improve our systems for agentic development: agent instructions, skills, and the test feedback loops that make agents effective across the codebase.
  • Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years building software at a product company: you've owned meaningful parts of a real production system.
  • Strong Java: REST APIs, database interactions, async processing.
  • TypeScript and a modern frontend framework: Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud).
  • Frontend fundamentals: complex UIs, component architecture, state management, performance, responsive design.
  • Solid SQL in a backend context: schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse.
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Architectural judgment: you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack.
  • DevOps fluency: containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, comfortable on Linux.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • An eye for design: you can spot a misaligned pixel.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.

Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.
No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

Why Join Us Now?

You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

· £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

· Over 1 million companies formed

· Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business

· Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong technical depth, particularly around APIs and integrations, to help shape the evolution of our platform. You'll own product strategy and execution for key areas of our integrated formation, compliance, accounting platform, balancing user needs, technical feasibility, and business goals as we scale.

As a thoughtful, technically fluent problem solver, you'll work closely with engineering to define API and integration strategy, partner with design on user-facing experience, and work with compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are met. You'll use data and user insights to prioritise the roadmap, and you're comfortable getting into technical detail with engineers, reviewing API contracts, understanding integration architecture, and making informed trade-offs on build vs. buy or partner integrations.

This is a hands-on senior role in a fast-paced environment where strong technical judgement, ownership, stakeholder communication, and a deep understanding of both user needs and system architecture are essential. If you're excited about building a platform that's genuinely integrated rather than stitched together and want to own product decisions from strategy through technical execution, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

· Own product strategy and roadmap for key platform areas, including integrations with third-party services (e.g. Companies House, accounting/payroll systems, payment providers)

· Define and prioritise the API and integration roadmap, working closely with engineering on technical design and architecture decisions

· Translate business and user requirements into clear technical specifications engineering can build against

· Partner with engineering to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and assess third-party integration partners

· Work with design to ensure user-facing experiences are well-supported by underlying technical architecture

· Partner with compliance to ensure new capabilities meet regulatory requirements (particularly relevant given the company formation/compliance context)

· Define and track product metrics, using data to inform prioritisation and validate outcomes

· Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, and technical constraints clearly to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams

· Run discovery with users and internal stakeholders to validate problems before committing engineering resource

· Mentor and support the development of other product managers, where applicable

What we are looking for

· 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of increasing scope and ownership

· Strong technical background, with hands-on experience working with APIs, integrations, and system architecture (e.g. having worked closely with engineering on integration builds, or come from a technical/engineering background)

· Demonstrated experience owning a product area with meaningful technical complexity (integrations, platform, or infrastructure-adjacent products)

· Excellent cross-functional communication, able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders

· Experience working within a startup or scaleup environment, comfortable with changing requirements and a fast pace

· Strong analytical mindset -comfortable with metrics, funnel analysis, and data-informed prioritisation

· Familiarity with compliance / regulatory constraints in product decisions (a plus, given the company formation and compliance context)

· Experience mentoring or providing product leadership to others

What We Offer

· £100k + and comprehensive benefits package

· Hybrid working model

· Real opportunities for progression as the business scales

· The chance to influence both customer experience and product development

· A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Equal Opportunities
1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. jobs.title: Product Manager, Courier Delivery Experience
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering.

You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces. 

The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience.

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products
  • Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges.
  • Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries.
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

  • Turn product releases into compelling narratives that explain clearly why new features matter to buyers.

  • Develop and maintain positioning that differentiates the product for different buyer personas and markets (e.g. enterprise IT leaders vs. AI leads).

  • Create clear product content: comparison pages, capability overviews, one-pagers, and campaign explainers.

  • Work directly with customers, support tickets, and sales calls to surface and translate user value into marketing and sales assets.

  • Enable sales and customer success with messaging frameworks, collateral, and ready answers to difficult product questions.

  • Help define category positioning for enterprise AI as the market and product evolve.

  • Participate in product reviews to understand what is being built and why.

  • Appear on camera and participate in public-facing demos or presentations as needed.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 3+ years of product marketing experience, specifically delivering go-to-market for software features or products.

  • Proven track record owning end-to-end GTM — from planning through execution across channels — with measurable impact.

  • Ability to explain technical products simply and accessibly to non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent, clear writing skills — clarity over cleverness, every time.

  • Habit of working with customers to surface value and translate it into marketing and sales assets.

  • Bias to own problems end-to-end without waiting for a brief.

  • Collaborative, kind approach to cross-functional teammates and customer-facing stakeholders.

Nice to have:

  • Experience targeting or selling into German enterprise IT markets (including the Mittelstand).

  • Background in B2B enterprise marketing, sales enablement, or category creation.

  • Comfort participating in product reviews and engaging with engineering or design teams.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is based on-site in Berlin, Germany. We're a small, collaborative team and value in-person work. Visa sponsorship is not available — candidates must already have the right to work in Germany.

jobs.description:
Expression of interest

We are actively building our talent pipeline for upcoming growth across the Scientific Data Architect team. Please note: This is an Expression of Interest advert, and there is no active vacancy at this exact moment. However, we anticipate opening formal roles in the coming months and want to connect with great talent early.

About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

Who You Are

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

What You Have Done

  • PhD or Masters with a number of years proven industry experience in life sciences  with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing.
  • Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments
  • Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders.
  • Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible.
  • Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities.
  • Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Do

  • You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI. As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the Frankfurt Region, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions.
  • Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability.
  • Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform.
  • Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including:
    • Data model design (tabular & JSON)
    • Python-based parser development.
    • Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs.
    • Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly) 
    • Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid)
    • Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files.
  • Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings
  • Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform.
  • Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases
  • Business proficiency of German required (C1 level)
  • Work on client site on average 3 days per week

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company.
  • Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO).
  • Flexible working arrangements - Remote work when not at Customer Sites

We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to design and evolve the frontend platform foundations that power n8n’s workflow-building experience, enabling product engineers and the open-source community to ship complex, reliable, and high-performance user experiences across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

As part of the team, you’ll take ownership of core frontend platform domains and help shape the architecture behind one of the most flexible automation products in the market:

Frontend platform architecture

  • Own and evolve core frontend platform primitives that make n8n’s workflow builder scalable, extensible, and maintainable.

  • Strengthen platform contracts such as plugin systems, extension points, and frontend developer experience.

  • Help modularize a large, evolving frontend codebase so product teams can build confidently on top of shared foundations.

Canvas, collaboration, and real-time systems

  • Work on the architecture behind n8n’s canvas-based workflow building experience.

  • Build and improve real-time collaboration capabilities using approaches such as WebSockets, CRDTs, or multiplayer synchronization patterns.

  • Design frontend systems with correctness, accessibility, and user experience in mind, especially for complex interactive workflows.

Performance and rendering foundations

  • Improve rendering performance, runtime behavior, and responsiveness across complex workflow-building experiences.

  • Use performance measurement, profiling, and optimization techniques to identify bottlenecks and improve user experience.

  • Contribute to web worker orchestration and other frontend infrastructure that helps n8n scale to more complex use cases.

Technical contribution and collaboration

  • Drive technical decisions through clear proposals, RFCs, and collaborative engineering discussions.

  • Partner closely with product engineers, QA, DX, Security, Staff Architects, and the open-source community to ensure platform changes integrate smoothly.

  • Support peers through code reviews, pairing, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🧱 Complex frontend systems: You’ve built architecture-heavy frontend products such as canvas-based tools, real-time applications, collaborative editors, or similarly complex interfaces.

  • ⚡ Performance and rendering depth: You can measure, debug, and improve runtime performance in large frontend applications.

  • 🛠️ TypeScript expertise: You have strong TypeScript frontend experience and are comfortable working in a large, evolving codebase.

  • 🏗️ Architectural ownership: You’ve owned meaningful frontend systems, led migrations, or re-architected complex areas of a product.

  • 🧠 Systems thinking mindset: You think in trade-offs, correctness, platform contracts, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

  • 🤝 Collaboration: You communicate clearly, work cross-functionally, and enjoy enabling other engineers rather than building in isolation.

  • 🧹 Pragmatic engineering: You’re excited by refactoring, modularization, tech debt reduction, and improving existing systems over time.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Real-time collaboration: You have experience with CRDTs, multiplayer systems, collaborative editors, or real-time communication layers.

  • 🧵 Frontend platform patterns: You’ve worked with plugin systems, extension architectures, micro-frontends, or web worker orchestration.

  • 🖥️ Vue experience: You have experience with Vue or are excited to work deeply in a Vue-based frontend codebase.

  • 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand public API contracts and backward compatibility.

  • 🧰 Developer tools or workflow products: You’ve worked on workflow engines, developer tools, infrastructure-adjacent SaaS, or other technical products.

  • 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve worked on systems with meaningful scale, complexity, or long-term maintainability challenges.

  • ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve built products that work across cloud, single-tenant, or self-hosted environments.

  • 🔭 Observability mindset: You care about instrumentation, debugging, rollout safety, and making complex systems easier to operate.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the frontend foundations behind a widely-used open-source automation platform — from the canvas experience and real-time collaboration layer to the performance, modularity, and platform contracts that help 80+ product engineers build faster. Your work will shape how technical teams and builders around the world create, scale, and collaborate on workflows across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

You’ll join a remote-first engineering org at a high-growth stage, as our Platform Engineering team scales from 8 to 17+ people by the end of 2026. That means you’ll have real architectural ownership, high visibility, and the opportunity to influence frontend standards, technical direction, and the culture of a team being built now.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager (equivalent to a technical account manager) to manage our rapidly growing enterprise customer base across all industries. As a Sr. CSM, you’ll work closely with sales, implementation, engineering and product while also working with a variety of customer stakeholders. You will advise customers on how to transform the way they manage B2B purchasing across their business, creating immediate value and efficiency for employees through product adoption and enablement.

This role is ideal for you if you enjoy being a product expert, creative problem solving, and want to work with a world-class team and customers such as Coinbase, Snowflake, Toast, Northwestern Mutual, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks, Miro, and many more.

You Will

  • Help our largest customers drive procurement success on the Zip platform.

  • Define customer business outcomes and partner with our customers to deliver those outcomes on a continuous basis.

  • Act as a trusted procurement advisor and thought partner to continuously educate and enable our customers on Zip’s platform and procurement best practices.

  • Identify champions and build relationships with key business stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT/Security, and Privacy/Compliance teams.

  • Maintain high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction with a focus on customer adoption and loyalty.

  • Manage customer health and hedge account risks based on data-driven adoption metrics.

  • Partner closely with product and engineering to translate business needs and requirements into new solutions for customers, while skillfully managing customer expectations.

  • Train and empower customers to be product specialists to become increasingly self-sufficient for their organization.

  • Partner with the renewals team to achieve target GRR.

  • Responsible for post implementation technical health of the client and perform hands on support in product adoption, and enablement.

jobs.title: ICT Outsourcing Manager
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

 

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

 

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

 

Your Mission

As our ICT Outsourcing Manager, you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. Over the next 6–12 months, your main focus will be to professionalise and stabilise our third-party management setup across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing relationships. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes.

In this role you will:

  • Act as the first line competence centre for ICT outsourcing and third-party governance topics, working across Technology, Compliance, Operations, business owners, and external partners to ensure risks and responsibilities are transparent and well managed.

  • Own the operational execution of our ICT third-party and outsourcing governance framework across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing arrangements, so that key relationships are assessed, documented, and monitored in line with regulatory expectations.

  • Drive risk assessments, due diligence processes, and recurring reviews for new and existing third parties, coordinating relevant stakeholders and turning findings into clear actions, decisions, and follow-ups.

  • Maintain and improve the outsourcing register, governance documentation, and supporting evidence base, creating the level of clarity and traceability needed for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and partners.

  • Prepare, structure, and run governance and review routines, including reporting, meeting preparation, escalation tracking, and action follow-up, to make third-party oversight more consistent, measurable, and decision-useful.

  • Identify and advance process improvements, standardisation opportunities, and selective AI-supported automation in recurring third-party management workflows, helping the function become more scalable and effective over time.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Bring hands-on experience in ICT outsourcing, third-party management, vendor risk, IT governance, compliance-related operations, or a similar function in a regulated environment.

  • Have a solid understanding of how external providers and outsourcing relationships are governed, documented, and monitored from a risk and compliance perspective.

  • Are comfortable working with risk assessments, service levels, control evidence, recurring reporting, and cross-functional governance routines.

  • Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, security-related topics, incidents, and operational dependencies without needing to be a security engineer.

  • Work in a highly structured and reliable way, with strong follow-up discipline, good judgment, and the ability to keep multiple stakeholders aligned.

  • Communicate confidently in German and English, and enjoy making complex governance topics clear, practical, and actionable.

 

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more / leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.


As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung (all Genders)
jobs.description:
DEINE KÜNFTIGE ROLLE.

Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung: Führen und selbst entwickeln.

Als Tech Lead übernimmst Du die technische Führung der Entwicklungsteams und stellst sicher, dass Softwarelösungen nachhaltig, skalierbar und wartbar umgesetzt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern und Entwicklern zusammen, übersetzt Architekturvorgaben in konkrete Lösungen und unterstützt die Teams bei technischen Entscheidungen. Dein Fokus liegt auf der erfolgreichen Umsetzung moderner Softwarearchitekturen, der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Entwicklungsprozesse sowie der Förderung technischer Exzellenz innerhalb der Teams. Dabei bleibst Du hands-on und entwickelst aktiv mit.

Wie die Rolle heißt, ist uns dabei weniger wichtig als das, was Du darin tust – bei anderen Arbeitgebern findest Du sie als Teamleitung Softwareentwicklung oder als Engineering Lead.

Klingt gut für Dich? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns!

Welche Aufgaben erwarten mich in meiner Rolle?
  • Technische Führung, Coaching und Coding-Unterstützung von Entwicklerteams.
  • Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Architekturvorgaben.
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Einführung neuer Produkte und Funktionen.
  • Verantwortung für die technische Qualität der entwickelten Software.
  • Definition und Durchsetzung von Entwicklungsstandards und Best Practices.
  • Mitarbeit bei Architekturentscheidungen sowie Erstellung technischer Konzepte.
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbau und Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mitarbeit bei Deployments.
  • Entwicklung und Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines.
  • Sicherstellung von Security-Anforderungen und Secure-Coding-Praktiken.
  • Unterstützung bei Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Konzepten.
  • Analyse und Lösung technischer Herausforderungen und Performance-Probleme.
  • Koordination technischer Aktivitäten innerhalb agiler Entwicklungsteams.
  • Durchführung von Code Reviews und Förderung hoher Softwarequalität.
  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne Stakeholder und Kunden.
Welche Fähigkeiten sollte ich mitbringen, um Teil des Teams zu werden?

Du begegnest Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit Respekt – nicht nur als Selbstverständlichkeit, sondern als gelebte Haltung. Dein klares Wertesystem prägt Dein tägliches Handeln und wird ergänzt durch einen Sinn für Humor, der das Team verbindet und für eine positive, motivierende Atmosphäre sorgt.

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science, Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie erste Erfahrung in technischer Führung.
  • Erfahrung mit modernen Softwarearchitekturen und agilen Entwicklungsmethoden.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Cloud-native-Architekturen, Container-Technologien und CI/CD.
  • Erfahrung in der Umsetzung skalierbarer und wartbarer Softwarelösungen.

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're an early-stage, AI-powered marketplace connecting Gen Z college students and young professionals with brand partners for paid work opportunities — from quick micro-tasks to longer-term gigs. Think of us as the talent and hiring platform built for the next generation, sitting at the intersection of the gig economy, career development, and brand marketing.

As our Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own full-funnel growth across two distinct audiences: student acquisition and brand partner expansion. You'll run paid and organic campaigns, design growth loops, and use AI tools to move fast and stay efficient. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role where you'll partner directly with senior leadership to shape strategy and execute.

This is a hybrid role based in Santa Monica, CA, with on-site presence required per company policy. Visa sponsorship is not available.

What You'll Do

  • Own execution and optimization of paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Search/YouTube, Meta (Instagram), TikTok, and retargeting channels.

  • Rapidly test new creative, audiences, and placements to reduce CAC and improve efficiency.

  • Leverage AI tools to scale ideation, creative production, copywriting, targeting experiments, and reporting.

  • Explore scrappy, unconventional growth tactics and organic channels (SEO/AEO, social, partnerships) alongside paid efforts.

  • Design and execute campaigns that move both students and brand partners from awareness to conversion.

  • Collaborate with sales to align brand-facing campaigns with pipeline goals.

  • Help run student acquisition programs including referral loops and ambassador initiatives.

  • Build and iterate nurture sequences to keep leads and users engaged across the funnel.

  • Support onboarding and lifecycle campaigns that drive student activity and brand partner retention.

  • Help execute upsell/cross-sell campaigns for existing brand partners.

  • Monitor and optimize retention metrics to improve LTV and reduce churn.

  • Track and analyze key growth metrics: CAC, CPL, MQLs, conversion rates, LTV, retention, and channel ROI.

  • Build dashboards and share insights regularly with leadership.

  • Run A/B tests across ad creative, landing pages, email sequences, and messaging.

  • Partner with creative to develop ad assets, landing pages, and case studies.

  • Collaborate with product to improve conversion flows and identify built-in growth loops.

  • Stay current on Gen Z trends, channel updates, and AI-driven growth tactics.

Required:

  • 3–5 years of experience managing full-funnel digital marketing campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and TikTok.

  • Proficiency with analytics and campaign measurement using Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Meta Ads Manager.

  • Experience using HubSpot for marketing automation, campaign tracking, and lead management.

  • Demonstrated ability to conduct organic growth experiments and implement product-led growth loops.

  • Strong track record of collaborating with senior leadership to develop and execute growth strategy.

  • Familiarity with Gen Z culture, behavior, and content trends.

  • Location: Santa Monica, CA, USA

Compensation details were not provided for this role. You'll be joining a small, fast-moving team at an early stage with meaningful ownership and direct impact on company growth.

jobs.title: SEO Automation Lead (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere ganzheitliche SEO-Strategie von Technical SEO über Content bis hin zu Offpage-Maßnahmen – und machst SEO zu einem zentralen Wachstumstreiber für Enpal.

  • Du führst und entwickelst das SEO-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch weiter, förderst individuelle Stärken und schaffst eine Kultur aus Eigenverantwortung, Lernen und messbaren Erfolgen.

  • Du steuerst die SEO-Roadmap strategisch, setzt klare Prioritäten und orchestrierst alle Maßnahmen entlang messbarer KPIs mit direktem Business Impact.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Communications, Product, Tech und Design zusammen und treibst technische wie inhaltliche SEO-Projekte partnerschaftlich und lösungsorientiert voran.

  • Du verantwortest zentrale Technical-SEO-Themen wie Crawlability, Indexierung, Site-Architektur, Core Web Vitals und strukturierte Daten und sorgst für eine nachhaltig skalierbare technische Basis.

  • Du entwickelst eine datengetriebene Content- und Linkbuilding-Strategie mit Fokus auf
    E-E-A-T, Keyword-Cluster und organisches Wachstum, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und Autorität kontinuierlich stärkt.

  • Du entwickelst eine zukunftsgerichtete GEO-Strategie (Generative Engine Optimization) zur Sichtbarkeit in KI-gestützten Suchmaschinen (ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) inkl. Content-Optimierung für LLM-Zitationen.

  • Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, erkennst Trends und neue Entwicklungen im SEO- und Marketing-Umfeld frühzeitig und nutzt sie, um zu experimentieren, zu lernen und neue Opportunities zu erschließen.

  • Du analysierst kontinuierlich Performance-Daten, leitest strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab und kommunizierst Erfolge, Learnings und nächste Schritte transparent an das C-Level.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst 5–7 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung mit und kannst nachweisliche Erfolge in der Steigerung organischer Sichtbarkeit, Traffic-Wachstum und Lead-Generierung vorweisen.

  • Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre Führungserfahrung – idealerweise beim Aufbau, der Entwicklung oder Skalierung von SEO-Teams – und verstehst es, Menschen zu befähigen und mitzunehmen.

  • Du verfügst über tiefgehende Expertise in allen SEO-Disziplinen: Technical SEO, On-Page, Content-Strategie und Offpage/Linkbuilding – und weißt, wie du diese strategisch miteinander verzahnst.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen SEO-Tools wie Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Sistrix, Google Analytics, Audisto oder Screaming Frog.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Developer-Teams und bringst ein solides technisches Verständnis mit (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs).

  • Du kennst dich mit KI-basiertem Arbeiten und GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) aus und hast bereits Erfahrung mit der Optimierung für KI-gestützte Suchmaschinen, LLMs und AI-Overviews gesammelt.

  • Du arbeitest unternehmerisch, denkst analytisch, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und richtest dein Handeln konsequent an messbarem Impact aus.

  • Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke, strukturierte und proaktive Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität und fließenden Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen.

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

jobs.title: Technical Founder's Associate (Berlin, on-site)
jobs.description:
sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

Join us and play a pivotal role in transforming the automation landscape in heavy industries.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on Founder's Associate to work directly with our founders in Berlin. This role suits a recent graduate who combines quantitative and economic thinking with real technical ability – the kind of person who can size a market in the morning, pull the numbers themselves in the afternoon, and spend the next day in the workshop or on-site getting hardware onto a machine. A meaningful part of this job is physical: moving machines, equipment, and hardware. You will do the work rather than coordinate it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own high-priority projects end to end on behalf of the founders, from customer pilots and field deployments to internal tooling and process automation.

  • Get hands-on with hardware – preparing and assembling sensor and compute kits, moving machines and equipment, and supporting installation, testing, and demos on-site.

  • Build the analysis behind key decisions – unit economics, pricing, market sizing, and machine performance data – pulling and cleaning the data yourself.

  • Prepare material for investors, grant programmes, and customers, and work across engineering, commercial, and operations teams to unblock execution.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field – a combination of the above is ideal.

  • Able to ship working software with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor – scripts, prototypes, and automations – with enough Python and SQL to review, debug, and trust what comes out.

  • Valid category B driving licence, and the willingness to drive to customer sites, transport equipment, and move machines and hardware.

  • Evidence of getting things done without supervision – a startup, a side project, a student venture, or a demanding internship.

  • Based in Berlin (or willing to relocate), happy to work on-site, and comfortable spending time in a workshop and around heavy machinery in operation.

Preferred Skills:

  • Practical workshop experience – wiring, mechanical assembly, prototyping, or vehicle work, whether from a robotics team, Formula Student, or personal projects.

  • Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, machine learning, or industrial hardware.

  • Experience operating vans, trailers, forklifts, or heavy equipment, or a willingness to be trained.

  • Practical experience building internal tools, dashboards, or automations with modern AI tooling.

  • Working knowledge of German, and interest in customers in mining, construction, or heavy industry.

What We Offer:

  • Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery – making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task

  • Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors

  • Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment

  • Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead

  • Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment


Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation package and stock options.

  • Beverages on-site and regular social events.

  • Engage with top-tier researchers, engineers, and thought leaders.

  • Influence the future of robotic technologies and tackle significant technological challenges.

  • Assistance with relocation to Berlin.


About Us:

Heavy machinery, light years ahead.

sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

We are proudly backed by Point Nine and other Tier 1 investors.
